propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must begin with a byte-identical shared plan prefix to enable within-run prefix reuse under Anthropic's whole-block cache breakpoint

The exhaustiveness directive ('enumerate EVERY independent defect you find in THIS run') must be injected as a single-sourced preamble bullet reachable by all Pass-1 entry points (finder, container, ISF)

The shared plan prefix is computed once in prompts.py via shared_plan_prefix(plan) and consumed by _resolve_system (Pass-1) and by verifier template rendering (via shared_prefix variable), with no re-inlining allowed

Verifier templates must drop the {{plan}} variable, volatile marker, and trailing plan block; finding listing moves entirely to user-turn (base_instructions → instructions), leaving the system prompt stable for caching
The Pass-1 warm gate must measure the actual cached bytes via _prefix_tokens(plan) rather than est_tokens(plan) to correctly gate on CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS
